image_description: A large, brown sea lion resting on a concrete dock or pier edge next to water. The animal is lying on its side with its head near the bottom right corner. Its body is streamlined and fusiform, covered in short, coarse fur that appears wet or sleek. The head shows visible external ear flaps and whiskers. The foreflippers are tucked under or alongside the body, not fully extended for walking. The background includes the edge of the dock and murky water.
